_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Yi jottu {player_id} ci Tic Tac Toe yu ñett ñiy jott. 
Ngone yi ni '{symbol}'.
Yi taxawal ngone yi ci tablo 5x5 bu gën a rëgg ci mbolem.
Mbolem yi am na ci ñaari gox: sax, des ak ndaw.
Soom na defte yi ci fórmát '[4]' bu gën a wàcce sel 4.

invalid_move.out_of_range: Nimeroo sel yu bon: {cell}. Wàcce wu nekk ci 0 ak {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Jëfandikukat {player_id} def na aw doxalin wu amul solo.

game_action.placed: Jottu {player_id} taxawal na ngone ({symbol}) ci kër ({row}, {col}).
